title: Career Roadmap: Data Engineer
summary: A Data Engineer designs, builds and maintains the systems that collect, transform, store and deliver data for analytics, business intelligence and machine learning. Unlike a Data Analyst, who primarily interprets data, a Data Engineer focuses on the infrastructure and pipelines that make reliable, usable data available.

blocks.text: A Data Engineer designs, builds and maintains the systems that collect, transform, store and deliver data for analytics, business intelligence and machine learning. Unlike a Data Analyst, who primarily interprets data, a Data Engineer focuses on the infrastructure and pipelines that make reliable, usable data available.
A BS in Data Science & Applications can provide a foundation for this career, particularly when combined with programming, databases, cloud computing, data modelling and software engineering skills.
Core responsibility
Build dependable data pipelines, integrate data from different sources, automate transformations and maintain data quality.
Work environments
Technology companies, banks, consulting firms, e-commerce businesses, cloud service teams, analytics departments and AI-focused organizations.

rows.text: Varies by institution and programme structure
Programming, statistics, databases, data structures and algorithms
SQL, Python, data modelling, ETL/ELT, distributed processing and cloud platforms
Data pipeline projects, internships and production-style portfolio work
Optional postgraduate study in data engineering, computer science, distributed systems or cloud computing

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: IIT-linked online and on-campus programmes can have different curricula, admission requirements and award structures. Verify the exact degree and programme details before enrolling. A degree title alone does not guarantee eligibility for every engineering position.
Year 1
Build programming foundations

items.text: Learn Python fundamentals, functions, modules and file handling.
Develop SQL skills and understand relational databases.
Study mathematics, statistics and basic data structures.
Practise Git, GitHub and command-line basics.

blocks.text: Year 2
Learn data engineering fundamentals

items.text: Build ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL.
Study database design, normalization and dimensional modelling.
Learn APIs, JSON, data validation and automated testing.
Explore workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow or similar tools.

blocks.text: Year 3
Develop production-ready skills

items.text: Learn cloud storage, data warehouses and access management.
Practise distributed processing using Apache Spark.
Build end-to-end batch data pipelines with monitoring and error handling.
Apply for internships and contribute to data-related open-source projects.

blocks.text: Final stage
Prepare for employment

items.text: Complete two or three substantial end-to-end projects.
Learn Docker, CI/CD basics and pipeline deployment.
Practise SQL interviews, Python problem-solving and system-design fundamentals.
Apply for Data Engineering Intern, Junior Data Engineer and ETL Developer positions.

blocks.text: Adapt the stages to the actual duration of the BS programme and the student's existing skill level.

rows.text: Python, functions, modules, error handling and testing
SQL, joins, window functions, indexing and query optimization
ETL/ELT, ingestion, transformation and data validation
Relational schemas, star schemas and dimensional modelling
AWS, Azure or Google Cloud fundamentals
Apache Airflow or an equivalent workflow scheduler
Git, Docker, logging, testing and CI/CD basics

blocks.text: Data Pipeline Engineering
Build systems that ingest data from databases, APIs, files and application events, then clean and transform it for downstream use.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: ETL Developer, Data Pipeline Engineer, Junior Data Engineer.
Cloud Data Engineering
Build and maintain cloud-based storage, processing and analytics systems with appropriate security, reliability and cost controls.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Cloud Data Engineer, Junior Cloud Engineer, Data Platform Engineer.
Big Data Engineering
Process large datasets using distributed computing, optimize data transformations and support high-volume analytical workloads.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Big Data Engineer, Spark Developer, Data Processing Engineer.
Data Platform and Analytics Infrastructure
Develop reusable data models, shared datasets, automated quality checks and reliable infrastructure for analysts and data scientists.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Analytics Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer.
Seek internships with technology companies, cloud consulting firms, fintech businesses, e-commerce platforms, analytics teams and organizations maintaining large databases.
Recommended portfolio projects

blocks.label: API-to-database pipeline
blocks.text: Extract data from a public API, validate it and load it into PostgreSQL.

blocks.label: Sales data warehouse
blocks.text: Transform raw transaction data into fact and dimension tables, then make it available for reporting.

blocks.label: Automated ETL pipeline
blocks.text: Use Python, SQL and a workflow scheduler to run transformations, log failures and retry tasks.

blocks.label: Cloud data pipeline
blocks.text: Store raw data in cloud storage, transform it and load it into an analytics destination.

blocks.label: Streaming data project
blocks.text: Ingest simulated events and process them using a suitable streaming or distributed-processing framework.

For every project, include an architecture diagram, setup instructions, sample data, tests, data-quality checks and a clear explanation of design decisions. Avoid publishing credentials or private data.
Useful options include:

items.text: SQL and relational database training.
Python programming and software testing.
Cloud fundamentals and cloud data services.
Apache Spark and distributed computing.
Data modelling and warehouse design.
Docker, Git and CI/CD fundamentals.

blocks.text: Cloud certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud can demonstrate platform knowledge, but they are optional for many entry-level roles. Prioritize projects and practical skills before collecting multiple certificates.
Data Engineering Intern
Assist with data ingestion, SQL and pipeline testing
Junior Data Engineer
Build and maintain data pipelines and transformations
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer
Design reliable, scalable data systems
Lead Data Engineer / Data Architect
Lead platform architecture, technical standards and engineering teams

Other possible directions include analytics engineering, cloud data platform engineering and machine-learning infrastructure. Progression depends on experience, system-design ability, reliability and technical leadership.

items.text: Lakehouse architectures and open table formats.
Real-time data processing and streaming analytics.
Data observability and automated data-quality monitoring.
AI-ready data pipelines and feature platforms.
Cloud cost optimization and data governance.
Secure data sharing and privacy-aware engineering.

blocks.text: AI coding assistants can speed up development, but data engineers must still understand pipeline correctness, security, performance, testing and failure recovery.
Preparation progress
Learn Python and advanced SQL fundamentals
Understand relational databases and data modelling
Build an ETL/ELT pipeline with data-quality checks
Create a data warehouse or cloud data project
Learn workflow orchestration and pipeline monitoring
Publish two or three documented portfolio projects
Prepare for SQL, Python and data-engineering interviews

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: Students pursuing a BS in Data Science & Applications should build strong foundations in Python, SQL and database design before moving into cloud platforms and distributed processing. Demonstrate your skills through complete, tested data pipelines and internships, and target entry-level roles that provide opportunities to learn production data systems.
